user.title: Connect to Growatt
user.description: Enter the Growatt account and inverter serial number. The connection is validated without changing inverter settings.

data_description.default_export_percentage: Local initial state before Growatt has received the first command.
data_description.default_meter_enabled: Leave disabled for normal unrestricted feed-in.

abort.already_configured: This Growatt controller is already configured.

init.title: Growatt export and price automation
init.description: Choose a detected electricity-price sensor and price strategy. Automatic economic mode uses the 2026 saldering value through 31 December 2026 and automatically switches to the tax-excluded return value from 1 January 2027. Manual thresholds remain available.

data.economic_2026_within_saldering: 2026 return stays within annual saldering allowance

data_description.price_sensor: Current quarter-hour electricity tariffs are preferred when available. Automatic economic mode can also use a tax-excluded current value exposed in the selected sensor forecast.
data_description.price_activation_threshold: Used only in Manual thresholds mode. Activate the low-price action at or below this EUR/kWh price.
data_description.price_recovery_threshold: Used only in Manual thresholds mode. Return to the normal action at or above this EUR/kWh price.
data_description.price_fixed_tax_eur_per_kwh: Used only for manual tax-basis conversion. Automatic economic mode never guesses missing tax-exclusive prices.
data_description.price_reapply_interval_minutes: Periodically resend the desired state because Growatt does not provide reliable readback. Set to 0 to disable periodic reapplication.
data_description.price_strategy: Automatic economic break-even switches at a net return value of 0 EUR/kWh. When triggered it uses Growatt zero-export (Meter Enable ON, export 0%) so solar remains available for self-consumption. When economic again it restores Meter Enable OFF and export 100%. Manual mode uses the activation and recovery thresholds below.
data_description.economic_2026_within_saldering: Enable this when your total annual grid export in 2026 is not higher than your annual grid consumption. This option is ignored from 1 January 2027.
data_description.economic_recovery_margin: In automatic economic mode, return to normal feed-in only when the economic value is at least this much above zero. Default: 0.005 EUR/kWh.
data_description.price_threshold_includes_tax: Used only in Manual thresholds mode.
data_description.price_vat_percent: Used only for manual tax-basis conversion.

error.price_sensor_required: Select an electricity-price sensor when automation is enabled.
error.price_sensor_not_found: The selected price sensor does not exist.
error.price_sensor_not_numeric: The selected price sensor does not currently have a numeric state.
error.recovery_below_activation: The recovery threshold must be equal to or higher than the activation threshold.
